name: Barrel
description: A wooden barrel. Cover to hide behind, and easily smashed.

name: Chest
description: An iron-bound chest, too heavy to move or break.

name: Barricade
description: Planks and crates piled high: blocks arrows and spells until it is hacked apart.

name: Pillar
description: Solid stone. Blocks movement and line of sight, and does not break.

name: Crate
description: A sturdy crate: cover that takes a few blows to break.

name: Boulder
description: A great rock. Blocks movement and line of sight, and does not break.
